kits.name: Studio Kit
kits.description: Handmade Danish DRS kit with Paiste 602 cymbals, close mics, overheads and room: a natural, open kit for pop, rock, funk, soul and jazz.

kits.name: Metal Kit
kits.description: The kit of Danish metal band Crocell, sampled in the studio with the band's own mics: tight double kick (left and right pedals), cutting snare, two chinas, splash, two crashes, ride and bell.

kits.name: Vintage Kit
kits.description: A vintage Polish kit by drum maker Zygmunt Szpaderski: big 24" kick, deep snare, four huge toms, rusty crash, ride and china. Warm and loose, for 60s/70s rock, soul, blues and garage.

kits.name: Brushes Kit
kits.description: The Big Rusty kit played with brushes: taps, slaps, a swirl, brushed hi-hat, toms and cymbals. For jazz, ballads, swing, bossa and quiet folk.
TR-808 sounds recorded from a Roland TR-8: deep and long kicks, snappy snare, clap, hats, toms, congas, cowbell. For trap, hip-hop, R&B, electro and Miami bass.
TR-909 sounds recorded from a Roland TR-8: punchy kick, snare, clap, hats, toms, crash and ride. For house, techno, garage, trance and drum & bass layering.

kits.name: 80s Digital
kits.description: A Yamaha RX5 (1986) digital drum machine: the bright PCM kit sound of the 80s, gated snare, full GM percussion. For synth-pop, new wave, 80s rock and city pop.

kits.name: Hand Percussion
kits.description: Congas, tumba, bongos, timbales, cowbell, agogo, shaker, cabasa, tambourine, claves, guiro, wood blocks, triangle and real hand claps. For latin, afro, salsa, funk, disco and pop layers.
